你可能还想知道。: A few things you might ask.
它会移动或修改我的文件吗？: Will it move or change my files?
不会。工作区保存的是文件引用，WorkTwill 不会移动、复制、重命名、删除或: No. Workspaces store references. WorkTwill does not move, copy, rename, delete, or modify your originals. Removing a resource from a workspace, or deleting the workspace itself, does not delete the original file.
需要联网、注册账号或配置 AI 吗？: Do I need an internet connection, account, or AI setup?
都不需要。文件检索、资料关联与工作区在本地运行。添加网页时，可选的自动标题功能会: No. File search, resource links, and workspaces run locally. When you add a URL, optional automatic title fetching connects to the destination website and resolves its domain through Cloudflare. You can turn this off and enter the title yourself.
它会读取我的所有文件吗？: Does it scan all my files?
只索引你明确授权的位置和文件，不会自动扫描全盘。目前搜索覆盖文件名称、路径、已保: Only the files and locations you explicitly allow are indexed. It does not automatically scan your whole drive. Search currently covers names, paths, saved URLs, and workspaces, not the contents of your documents.
网页也能加入工作区吗？: Can I add web links to a workspace?
可以。粘贴网址即可保存网页引用，标题可以手动修改。打开时使用系统默认浏览器；不会: Yes. Paste a URL to save a reference and edit its title if needed. Links open in your default browser. WorkTwill does not store page contents or read your browser's login sessions.
改名或移动文件后，还能找到吗？: What happens if I rename or move a file?
当前 macOS 候选版已接入部分同物理对象改名与同卷移动定位。跨卷移动、某些软: The current macOS candidate can relocate the same physical file after some renames and moves within a volume. Cross-volume moves and replacement saves in some apps still have limitations. If identity cannot be confirmed, references are kept for you to relink explicitly. A matching name never automatically takes over a reference.
这是免费或开源软件吗？: Is WorkTwill free or open source?

安装与第一次打开: Install and open for the first time
获取 ZIP，解压后得到 WorkTwill.app。: . Extract the ZIP to get WorkTwill.app.
可将应用放入「应用程序」文件夹，通过 Finder 打开。: You can place the app in your Applications folder and open it through Finder.
由于尚未签名和公证，macOS 可能阻止运行。请核对官网下载文件的 SHA-25: macOS may block this unsigned, unnotarized build. Verify its source and SHA-256 before deciding whether to allow it to run. An unsigned build has not passed Apple's security review.
打开后进入「个人工作台」，没有预置业务数据，也不会自动扫描你的电脑。: The app opens to My workspace with no sample business data. It does not automatically scan your computer.
点击「添加管理位置」，选择一个现有文件夹。桌面、下载和文档只作为选择器起点，确认: Choose Add managed location and select an existing folder. Desktop, Downloads, and Documents are starting points for the picker, not automatic scan permissions. You can also allow individual files without scanning their parent folder.
应用只索引明确授权的资料。原文件保持原样，索引与工作区关系保存在应用独立的本地数: Only explicitly authorized resources are indexed. Originals remain unchanged; the index and workspace relationships live in the app's separate local data directory.
新建一个工作区，例如「客户合同」或「新同事入职」。: Create a workspace, such as Client contract or New hire onboarding.
从搜索结果添加文件，也可使用「选择本地文件」或拖入文件。: Add files from search, choose local files, or drag them into a workspace.
点击「添加网页」粘贴网址，自动获取的标题可以编辑，也可以关闭自动获取并手填。: Choose Add web link and paste a URL. Edit the fetched title, or disable title fetching and enter it yourself.
双击资料，或点击打开按钮，用系统默认软件打开原件。: Double-click a resource or use its open button to open the original in the system's default app.
同一份资料可以加入多个工作区。从工作区移除资料、转移关联或删除工作区，只改变引用: One resource can belong to multiple workspaces. Removing or transferring a reference, or deleting a workspace, only changes links inside WorkTwill. It does not move or delete originals on disk.
右侧顶部搜索常驻，macOS 可用 ⌘K 聚焦。搜索覆盖已索引的名称、路径、网址: Search is always available at the top of the content area. Press ⌘K on macOS to focus it. Search covers indexed names, paths, URLs, and workspaces, not document contents. Narrow results by workspace, type, or date.
「动态」可以按日查看文件修改、首次发现和应用内打开。「首次发现」是应用收纳时间，: Activity shows file modifications, first discoveries, and in-app opens by day. First discovered means when WorkTwill first collected a resource, not when the file was created. Edits made while the app is closed are not reconstructed into a complete history.
当前 macOS 候选版接入了部分同物理对象改名与同卷移动定位，旧管理位置可能需: The current macOS candidate supports some relocation of the same physical file after a rename or move within a volume. Older managed locations may need to be selected again. Cross-volume moves and some apps' replacement saves still need verification. If identity is uncertain, relationships are kept and you can explicitly relink the original. Matching names do not automatically inherit references.
macOS 应用数据位于 ~/Library/Application Suppo: On macOS, app data lives in ~/Library/Application Support/app.worktwill.desktop/. Back up data in Settings saves workspaces, relationships, favorites, and URLs, not original files. Backups contain resource names, paths, and locator information; keep them somewhere you trust.
恢复会替换当前应用资料，并事前保留当前库副本。恢复后需重新授权目录或单文件。请同: Restoring replaces current app data and first keeps a copy of the current database. Reauthorize folders or individual files after a restore. Keep your own original-file backups too; an app backup does not replace them.
当前仅提供 macOS Apple 芯片的本机构建候选包。本机 WPS 的部分原: Only a locally built macOS Apple Silicon candidate is currently available. Some in-place saves and Save As behavior have been observed in WPS on the development machine. This does not establish support for every Office save operation, cross-volume identity continuity, Windows, or signed releases.

WorkTwill 不要求注册或登录。文件元数据、工作区关系、收藏、网址和搜索索: WorkTwill requires no signup or login. File metadata, workspace relationships, favorites, URLs, and search indexes stay in the app's data directory on your computer. They are not automatically uploaded to this website or a cloud service.
只索引你明确授权的文件与文件夹，不会自动扫描全盘。应用通过引用组织资料，不修改原: Only files and folders you explicitly authorize are indexed. The app does not automatically scan your whole drive. Resources are organized through references without changing originals or their metadata. You can revoke access in Settings.
网页标题与外部打开: Web titles and opening external resources
添加网址时，如果开启自动获取标题，应用会访问目标网站，并通过固定 Cloudfl: If automatic title fetching is enabled when you add a URL, the app contacts the destination website and resolves its domain through a fixed Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS service. These services receive the network information needed to complete the request. Turn title fetching off to enter titles manually.
应用不读取浏览器登录态，不保存网页正文，也不执行页面脚本。打开文件使用系统默认软: The app does not read browser login sessions, store page contents, or run page scripts. Files open in the system's default app and URLs in the default browser. Those apps and websites have their own data practices.
本官网没有账号、联系表单、广告或第三方统计脚本。页面使用本地打包的资源，不从外部: This website has no accounts, contact forms, ads, or third-party analytics scripts. Resources are bundled locally rather than loaded from external font or icon services. The interactive demo uses fictional sample data, does not access your files, and does not save your input.
网站和下载通过 Cloudflare 提供。访问时，Cloudflare 会为内: Cloudflare serves this website and its downloads. It processes necessary data such as IP addresses and request details for delivery, security, and operations under its applicable policies. The absence of analytics scripts does not mean the network provider processes no access data.
应用备份不包含原文件，但可能包含资料名称、路径、网址和定位信息。请保存在你认可的: App backups exclude originals but may contain resource names, paths, URLs, and locator information. Keep them in a location you trust. There is currently no cloud sync across devices or online resource recovery service.
未来如增加账号、云同步、统计或 AI 功能，会更新说明并明确相应范围。当前官网不: If accounts, cloud sync, analytics, or AI features are added, this notice will be updated to explain their scope. Planned features are not presented as available on this website.
